server_api_v4.transport: HTTPS POST application/json; localhost is the historical HTTPS exception
server_api_v4.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <agent token>; server stores SHA256(token) and requires active agent
important_semantics: request_id reuse across another attempt is rejected
same request_id with a different mutation body is rejected as request_body_conflict
claimed destination snapshot is immutable evidence; missing/corrupt snapshot fails closed
accept binds durable local_receipt_id and content_sha256 before print execution
start is idempotent when already started and otherwise requires claimed state
report accepts submitted|failed|unknown|recovery_hold and requires matching local receipt
server identity/scope binding prevents backlog from silently moving to another server

loopback_bridge_v1.authentication: exact Origin match plus X-Sokna-Bridge-Pairing fixed-time comparison
loopback_bridge_v1.pairing: 24 random bytes encoded as 48 lowercase hex on first creation; stored under ProgramData and reloadable by file rotation

/v1/wake.expiry_rule: explicit timezone offset; not older than 5 seconds and not beyond 2 minutes
/v1/wake.replay_rule: request_id retained in in-memory replay map until expires_at; duplicate returns idempotent=true

v3_ownership_correction.runtime_relationship: Runtime may supervise Print Agent service lifecycle only
v3_ownership_correction.local_relationship: Local owns business print intent/document meaning and submits through a versioned contract
do_not_preserve_as_authority: dev39 packaging statement that Print Worker is an internal Local component
forbidden: printing failure rolling back unrelated committed business state

next_contract_work: extract exact action request/response schemas for the subset retained by V3
decide whether wake/preview remain a browser-to-agent loopback subprotocol or become internal adapters
define V3 submission envelope and document payload version around proven accept/start/report fence semantics
map historical attempt/spooler states to V3 without weakening unknown/recovery_hold behavior
add compatibility vectors and physical-printer UAT requirements
